# Sleepwalker

> A mythic science-fiction story of seven children, an impossible book and ruins on distant worlds that answer their dreams.



## Start here

- [Sleepwalker](https://sleepwalker.in/index.md) ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/))

- [Thoughts](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/index.md): Two connected inquiries: the Vedic world and the methods of creative expression. ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/))

- [Blog](https://sleepwalker.in/blog/index.md): Standalone essays on cosmic scale and the craft of making a story. ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/blog/))

- [About Sleepwalker](https://sleepwalker.in/about/index.md): A mythic science-fiction graphic novel by Harsh Joshi, with an inquiry into its Vedic world and methods for making it. ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/about/))


## Collections

- [Creative methods](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/creative-methods/index.md): How visual intention, generative tools and structured continuity can support deliberate making. ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/creative-methods/))

- [The Vedic-world inquiry](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/vedic-world-inquiry/index.md): Markandeya's changing encounters and the movement of inward sound open questions about scale, attention and devotion. ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/vedic-world-inquiry/))


## Reading journeys

- [From frame to sequence](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/creative-methods/from-frame-to-sequence/index.md): Carry a visual choice through character continuity into the reader's inference between panels. ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/creative-methods/from-frame-to-sequence/))

- [Through Markandeya's encounters](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/vedic-world-inquiry/through-markandeyas-encounters/index.md): A reading of adjacent Bhāgavata chapters, from recognition inside an immense world to the devotion its witness asks to keep. ([HTML](https://sleepwalker.in/collections/vedic-world-inquiry/through-markandeyas-encounters/))
